title: Google Project Zero Sets Course for 30-Day Disclosure Deadline
description: Google Project Zero is progressively shortening its vulnerability disclosure deadlines, moving from a 90-day window to 60 days in February 2027, and then to 30 days in January 2028. The policy removes the previous 30-day grace period for patch roll-out and most special cases, except for actively exploited vulnerabilities and those already public. This change aims to encourage faster vendor remediation and improve overall vulnerability management processes.
